# NOTES ON THE TWO BOOKS (for later Q&A)

## BOOK 1 of 2: "Through the Sun in an Airship" by John Mastin (Gutenberg #77867; London: Charles Griffin & Co., 1909)

**Front matter:** Epigraph from Churchill. Dedication to Prof. Sir Hubert von Herkomer, "by his former pupil the author," Totley Brook near Sheffield, June 1909. Author lists: F.S.A. Scot., F.L.S., F.C.S., F.R.A.S., F.R.M.S., R.B.A.; other works: "Parasites of Insects," "The True Analysis of Milk," "Plate-Culture and Staining of Amœbæ," "The Stolen Planet," "The Immortal Light."

**Chapter list:** I The Story of the *Regina*; II The *Regina* Gives Up Her Secret; III Vox Populi; IV Muscæ Vomitoriæ; V An Innocent Offender; VI The Doomed Planet; VII The Story of a Star; VIII A Jovian Bug; IX Testing the Web; X The Conspiracy; XI "The Impregnable Rock"; XII Through Fire and Flame and Mystery; XIII "Vaults of Purple"; XIV Between Two Worlds; XV Joci Causâ; XVI "A Race of Laughing Philosophers"; XVII Small Profit and Quick Return.

**Ch I (Derwent, England; Ross Ainley, Gilbert Eastern):** Picnic by river Pole in "Garden of the Earth," North Pole region. Gilbert throws away a bad capsule egg (supplier Flatters). Ross complains of over-science, eggs, salmon; praises past. Gilbert defends Government-run order (no poverty, prisons pay back victims). Meet Dennis Oakland (electrical expert, tied with Ross in exam; owner of airship *Regina*). Second moon "Bona" appeared, ~ a century ago; increased gravity earlier. Dennis's ancestor Jervis Meredith (with Fraser Burnley) wrote "The Stolen Planet"; Burnley was annihilated by current when opening shed (~1990s-era history). Dennis's father, dying, told Dennis to keep secret (Dennis promised; secrets lost). Shed protective force: anything within 12 inches volatilised. Dennis's father and generations failed; Dennis blew up shed with rystosol. Ross and Gilbert agree to help; Dennis permits Ross to try, on condition secret kept. Thing said "Derwent" is city.

**Ch II:** Next day in shed; Dennis tosses hammer—vaporised. Ross and Gilbert work two years; storm-lightning gives idea. Hats thrown at ship stick (first time anything passes zone). Dennis enters first, then others; they take the keys/papers from desk. Crowd (led by Richard Howett) breaks in, thinks them dead. Dennis's demonstration: floats people up, "Ye floating spirits" speech; citizens made light, later restored. Government deputation refused; warrant signed by King Edward VII protects secret.

**Ch III:** Party. Government official Solomon Magson (suffers *caput inflatum*) tests: steel bar liquid; Ross floats him to roof. Women's-rights satire ("husband and wife"/"wife and husband"). Ship flies to Bona; 13 June chosen; "Kidney" valley destination. Ships crowd Derwent, cable snarls; *Regina* rises through shaft of ships (shaft demonstration), paper souvenir floats. Ship vanishes to Bona in sunrise.

**Ch IV (Bona):** Gilbert, Ross, Dennis land in "Kidney" valley; Ross and friends bathe in pools, stick, then soak in spring stream; become prussian-blue dyed. Natives (Bonians) unfazed; natives use rods (magnetic steel) to paralyse; bonians cure with ointment; Ross vain about complexion. Bonians send messages to other planets but Earth isolated from telepathy; wave system fails from Bona. Bonians: "spirits of vegetation," cultivate plants; microbe/bug (grub) from Jupiter, fire-proof; mummy seeds story. Dennis picks Godfrey Spenser (microscopist, crank about electricity) as expert.

**Ch V (Earth):** Godfrey Spenser joins; plan: cultivate fire-proof grub to make web net to shield *Regina* from sun. 19 Sept, cloudy night, departure; red floating light signal. Godfrey burns hand touching switch (forbidden); promises. Heat lecture (Gilbert: heat as motion; Rumford, Davy 1798-1812; water anomalies). Ship mistakenly diverted (Godfrey's switch) toward Luna (Moon). Luna visit: dark side inhabitants aggressive; sunny side Lunians; rays from Tycho; message sent to Earth ("we are investigating Luna").

**Ch VI (Jupiter; Mars):** Jupiter: 490 million miles from Sun, ~1400× Earth; seventeen moons. Belts = dust. Godfrey tries to fetch bug; dropped beast explodes killing people. Ship goes to Mars (doomed, drying). Martians imprison four (Dennis, Ross, Gilbert, Godfrey—Godfrey claims expert, imprisoned for life; others sentenced to death in three days). Martian captive Werran (interpreter). Dennis tortures a captive for information (Ross's current). Ship lifts prison walls; Godfrey rescued; soldiers levitated.

**Ch VII (Jupiter, Kulametik):** Werran (Martian general) sees star-light ray showing history of a world. Jovians bring hundreds of animals ("Noah's ark"); Werran's first laugh. Jovians call Earth "Gorok," Mars "Lazak," Sun "Kulik." Kulametik farm; large beast whose spinal fluid is deadly. Werran returned to Mars; red light beacon shining over his house.

**Ch VIII:** Gorokakak grub; life cycle; fire-proof hairs/web (2 years weaving). Kidnap of Gilbert by cable-noose; *Regina* sinks pirate airship, killing its pilot; pirate-airship burned. Government takes no action. Announcement: "The *Regina* will sail within ten days into the Sun."

**Ch IX:** Net woven; demonstration; twenty visitors invited (scientists). Round-Earth test flights. Compartments/sehen-microphones. Water compressed into cords. Moral digressions (Solomon proverbs). Ship goes toward sun.

**Ch X:** Stars described (variables, Mira Ceti). Eight mutineers led by Edgar Holt (also Bosworth Keeth) plot seizure; Gilbert records it with sehen-microphones. Mutineers marooned on a wandering planet near Venus (cooling, with purple phosphorescence) after settling on a continent; Dennis's prayer. Approach to Sun; Rollsborough (astronomer), Price Rowland, Raymond Sorrel (geologist), Merrick Rutherford, Kirkby Reeve, Lees Ingle, Morris Farrant, etc. Corona; photosphere.

**Ch XI:** Godfrey and Raymond Sorrel discuss Bible vs science; Sorrel's creation sequence; bullet experiment on coalescence; nitrogen-withdrawal sun-making. Explosion in laboratory (Gilbert's box breaks).

**Ch XII:** Corona/photosphere description; sun spots; sun gravity 28.75; diameter ~873,105 miles; sun-sea tidal wave survived. Descent through sun; Godfrey's "I am afraid..." speech; Gilbert's darkness; flight into a nitrogen interior.

**Ch XIII:** Interior nitrogen, sound; fog changes to oxygen; "sound" detected; light below; will-o'-wisp landscape; Godfrey laughs—"clouds with light on them"; Earth-like clouds, mare's tails; land below; insects (golden, green-elytra) clinging; Fiji mention (2316 AD tidal wave).

**Ch XIV:** Inner sun-sea; birds; sea; moral reflections; sleepless sea; "nebulous" beings seen; Rutherford's theories of angels; Reeve; illness forces return; Sorrel's sun-formation theory; ship returns with sick.

**Ch XV (Joci Causâ):** Mutineers lost; locate a planet (Ramsar? "Nova") near Venus; attractive force on star; natives—Dennis wrenches a planet; horses swim; Kelman; Ingle injured; "solid" water; hairy sexless beings; planet hauled ("Eleven men ... wrench a planet from its course"). Rollsborough and Sorrel object.

**Ch XVI:** Planet (called Ramsar) inhabitants: mutineers (Holt, Keeth, Congreve, Siddall, Dawson, Wadsworth, Hewitt, Bolford, Fred Congreve etc.) dumped there; they corrupt the peaceable people with alcohol, tobacco, gambling; world darkens; electrical storm; cave survival; Dawson's death-bed words; regret of Siddall; rescue.

**Ch XVII:** Regina attracts planet back (Gilbert, Dennis, Ross); Godfrey's speech "Be merciful"; the planet returned to orbit, mutineers picked up; "In three days expect the *REGINA*!" Ad pages for *The Immortal Light* and *The Stolen Planet*.

## BOOK 2 of 2: "Olga Romanoff" by George Griffith (Gutenberg #54096; London: Simpkin, Marshall, 1897)

**Front matter:** Dedication to Hiram Stevens Maxim. Frontispiece "Evil in such a shape might be something more than good." Author of "The Angel of the Revolution," "The Outlaws of the Air," etc.

**Prologue: The Prophecy of Natas:** Israel di Murska (Natas), Master of the Terror, writes ~1930: Aerians in valley of Aeria (Central Africa). Richard Arnold built first aircraft (1903); Alan Tremayne united Anglo-Saxons; Alexander Romanoff (last Tsar) defeated 8 Dec 1904 (Muswell Hill/London). Natasha ("Angel of the Revolution") pleaded mercy. Aerian command of air; prophecy of a flaming sword/fire-messenger from stars after 5th generation; surviving in caverns.

**Ch I (8 Dec 2030, St Paul's):** Supreme Council (President Alan Arnold) abdicates world-throne; reads Natas message; speech. Aerians keep command of the air.

**Ch II:** Night, Hampstead turret. Paul Romanoff (old, Russian last of line; alias Paul Ivanitch sculptor) and granddaughter Olga Romanoff (~17, dark beauty). Death-draught; Serge Nicholaivitch (Romanoff, ~22, Olga's betrothed) arrives; oath to take Paul's ashes to Petersburg (SS Peter & Paul) and wed at Moscow. Paul shows Imperial crown in steel cavity. Paul's speech: Vladimir Romanoff (Olga's father) killed by Terrorist air-ship in Norway forest; plans to rule Aeria. Paul dies reaching for crown.

**Ch III:** Cremation at Highgate; will shows scientific plan; Olga steals slip of parchment (Vladimir's secret: solar-coal electrical power; explosives). Olga crowns herself and Serge at Hampstead mirror.

**Ch IV:** Eastern express from London Continental Station; Alan Arnoldson (son of President) and Alexis Masarov (Aerians) on train; Alderman Heatherstone. Channel Bridge. Alan's pledge of secrecy; "Coming Race" (Lytton) referenced.

**Ch V:** Berlin/Königsberg; Olga postpones marriage. Air-ship *Ithuriel* swoops by train; Olga asks for flight.

**Ch VI:** Olga's chemical preparation: white and blue fluids ("Elixir of Death"); dream of Aeria vision (air-ship battle, Aeria valley). Breakfast; Olga charms Alan.

**Ch VII:** Sleigh race; Peter-Paul dungeon plate: Natas imprisoned 1881. Skating; Olga describes Aeria (she "saw" it). Olga plans drugging crew. Punch drugged; Serge enthralled. Ithuriel boards at Hotel garden.

**Ch VIII:** Ithuriel disappears (2030-31); bodies of eight Aerians found in Norway snowdrift 2032 (?). New Terror: transports *Massilia*, *Ceres*, *Astræa*, *Sirius* sunk; submarine navies destroyed. Olga's letter (1 May 2036) dropped from sky: "They have served my turn..." Olga signature.

**Ch IX (Flight of the Revenge):** Aerian fleet (Ithuriel, Ariel) pursues renamed *Revenge*; Boris Lossenski and Levin Ostroff gunners; battle; Antarctic pursuit, Erebus, Olga's fleet annihilated. Council discusses.

**Ch X:** Alan's letter (Narwhal, Kerguelen); Alma Tremayne (grey eyes, Alan's betrothed) on terrace; Isma Arnold and Cygna boat; Mars.

**Ch XI:** Snake in Eden discussion between Alma and Isma.

**Ch XII (Battle of Kerguelen, Christmas Harbour):** Max Ernstein; Edward Forrest; Alan & Alexis repulse Russian attack; Alexis rams submarines with needle-detection; Narwhal to Mount Terror, torpedoes collapse tunnel.

**Ch XIII:** Alan's report: Kishenov, Louis Khemski, Mount Terror. Alexis's plan. Narwhal blocks tunnel.

**Ch XIV:** Vega returns; Council reply; new Ithuriel command; letters from Isma and Alma (photographs).

**Ch XV:** Olga in Council; Lossenski advises alliance with Sultan Khalid; Michael/Orloff Lossenski, Boris, Turgenieff; plan.

**Ch XVI:** Khalid the Magnificent (Alexandria, palace); Lossenski's letter; Alan's Ithuriel captures Vindaya; Khalid sees islet destroyed; pledges one-year truce.

**Ch XVII:** Olga goes to Alexandria; Musa al Ghazi (Grand Vizier) drugged; Mecca; Olga apostasy; unholy alliance.

**Ch XVIII:** Alan's ultimatum; Vindaya renamed *Isma*; Council orders attack on Alexandria.

**Ch XIX:** Olga on palace roof; Alan confronts; Sultan forces truce; Olga accuses Alan of crimes; Khalid's reply; Olga's threat.

**Ch XX:** Aerian fleet to London; King Albert II; Alan takes charge of Anglo-Saxon defence; threatens parliament.

**Ch XXI:** Return to Aeria, 11 May 2037; Alma and Isma; Alan restored Golden Wings; Temple with urns (Natas, Richard Arnold, Natasha, Alan & Muriel Tremayne); Avenger flagship (renamed *Alma* later).

**Ch XXII:** War preparations; Alan & Alexis's fleets; farewell; marriage plans.

**Ch XXIII:** 16 May 2037 war begins; Alan's *Avenger* destroys Alexandria aerial ships; Moslem transports sunk by submarines (Max Ernstein's magnet and phonetic indicator); million men lost.

**Ch XXIV:** Avenger over Moscow; Russian ships destroyed; Gibraltar; Alexis captures Haroun; Russian/Moslem air-battle; Paris bombarded; Azrael recall order from President (Aeria).

**Ch XXV:** Vassilis Cosmo receives Mars signal: comet will destroy Earth (23 Sept 2037). Natas's "Interpretation" document read.

**Ch XXVI:** Temple announcement; Council selects Children of Deliverance; Alan refuses exemption; Alexis oath.

**Ch XXVII:** Alan and Alma reconcile at palm-grove ("Only you can bid me live, Alma").

**Ch XXVIII:** Caverns of Mount Austral; sluice-door; Fire-Cloud; Olga's isolation; Aeria isolated.

**Ch XXIX:** Alan and Alma's weddings; Alan and Alexis go to Alexandria under truce; Olga and Khalid arrive; Olga's bullet/scar; Alma's rebuke; Olga's threat "Whatever comes!"; Alan wounds Lossenski (killed), Olga scarred.

**Ch XXX:** Khalid learns Hakem's confirmation; Olga's attempt; Alan's escape; world tour; madness; Aeria epidemic; selection.

**Ch XXXI:** Battle of Aeria (final); lake floods valley; Olga's fleet destroyed; Alan and Alexis close doors.

**Ch XXXII:** Olga escapes to Mount Terror; Boris poisons crew; shoots Khalid; Olga's own shot of Boris; Khalid's wound; Olga and Khalid survive in cavern.

**Epilogue ("Vengeance is Mine"):** Sept 26; caverns open; Aeria a swamp; Alan and Alma visit Mount Terror; Olga insane, paralysed; she calls Alan dead; Alma's "God forgive her." THE END.
